name: QiYi Sandwich Cube 3x3 (Magnetic)
description: The QiYi Sandwich Cube 3x3 (Magnetic) is a beginner-friendly magnetic speed cube built to get kids turning and solving without the usual frustration. Its simplified color layout and bright, frosted pieces lower the learning threshold while the magnetic positioning keeps every turn stable and snappy.
features: Built for first-time solvers: A simplified layout and lower step count make this an approachable entry point for kids picking up a cube for the first time.
Magnetic positioning: Magnets help each layer settle into place, so turns stay stable and little hands aren't fighting a loose, wobbly cube.
Bright, easy-to-read colors: The full-bright stickerless scheme keeps colors clearly distinct while kids play.
Grows with the cuber: A proper magnetic build means kids aren't stuck re-buying once they outgrow a cheap starter.
Frosted surface: The matte frosted plastic is scratch-resistant, anti-reflective, and resists fingerprints.
Stable rotation: The magnetic system delivers steady, controlled turning without the looseness common on traditional children's cubes.
